criteria.name: profile_sync_correctness
criteria.description: Current user profile is sourced from main app context and/or real profile records, including when workspace member rows miss the current user.

criteria.name: mock_ui_removal
criteria.description: Remaining profile/member mock labels are replaced with truthful loading or unsynced states without pretending fake identity exists.

criteria.name: logic_preservation
criteria.description: Skill catalog, member skill CRUD, sharing scope, and RLS-aware data access behavior remain intact.

criteria.name: runtime_quality
criteria.description: Tests/build and browser smoke pass without new console/runtime or visible layout regressions.
